These '''chambers''' were located in a building in [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia's]] [[Malidris|capital city]].

==History==
[[File:HolographicDarthMaul.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The [[solid-state hologram]] of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] attacks.]]

The chambers consisted of several rooms with big, open [[Window/Legends|windows]] facing the [[Capital Square]]. It had a [[Sleeper (furniture)|bed]], at least one sofa and a workbench. The chamber walls were carved with ornate patterns.

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] once stayed in this apartment while visiting Iridonia as a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]]. Here, he was attacked by a [[solid-state hologram]] of the late [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], but survived.
